An attacker exploited a remote code execution flaw in SGLang, an open-source inference engine, and ran code on one of NEAR AI's inference servers last Sunday.

title: SGLang RCE Exploit Breaches NEAR AI, Steals Data From 18 Agents and About 100 Users

description:
A flaw in Git can let a malicious repository run an attacker's code on a computer that clones it recursively, together with its submodules. The Git project fixed it this week in Git 2.56.1, with matching fixes for the 2.50 through 2.55 series in 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1 and 2.55.1.

title: Git Patches Flaw That Lets Malicious Repositories Execute Code During Recursive Clones

title: Fireworks AI Breach Widens to Expose Customer Billing Data and Incomplete Model Weights

title: Attackers Exploit AhsayCBS Flaws to Deploy Sandbox-Evading Python Backdoor

description:
An iMessage flaw could let a remote attacker join a group chat and receive its messages, Apple said yesterday, and it released updates to fix it. The updates also fix a separate iMessage flaw that could let someone added to a group access messages sent before they joined.

As of today, other updates released yesterday for the iPhone XS, XS Max and XR, the iPad (7th generation) and some Apple
title: Apple Patches iMessage Group Chat Privacy Flaws and Bluetooth Pairing Vulnerabilities

description:
An October cyberattack on refrigeration controllers at about 700 French retail sites was carried out by a cyber unit of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), the French government said yesterday.

The attackers broke into controllers on the night of October 11 and changed their defrost settings to high temperatures. That caused food losses and, in at least 15 cases, fires.

title: France Blames Iran for Sabotage Attack on Refrigeration Controllers at About 700 Retail Sites

description:
Four flaws that attackers could exploit without logging in were fixed today as part of SAP's monthly Security Patch Day—the vendor rates all four 10.0, the maximum CVSS score.

Three are in the SAP NetWeaver application server, the software SAP systems run on, and one is in the Web Dispatcher, which receives web requests from the internet and passes them on to that server.

title: SAP Patches Four CVSS 10.0 Flaws, Including Two Enabling Remote Code Execution

N-able said it has taken N-central Hosted Environments offline and is urging on-premises customers to shut down their servers until further notice following the public disclosure of over 30 vulnerabilities collectively tracked as Able2Shell.

title: N-able Takes N-central Cloud Offline After Researcher Discloses 33 Zero-Days with PoC Exploits

description:
Google on Monday released updates to patch nine security vulnerabilities, including one that has come under active exploitation in the wild.

title: Google Issues Chrome Security Update for Eighth Actively Exploited Zero-Day of 2026
